arg.name: world_endpoint
arg.description: the world server's ZMQ endpoint; empty keeps the config file's (default tcp://127.0.0.1:5590)

arg.name: world_render
arg.description: true | false: ask the world server to render every frame (Isaac: for watching; an ego with a lidar renders anyway); empty keeps the config file's (default false)

arg.name: world_request_timeout_seconds
arg.description: how long a world server request may take before the bridge is wedged and exits for a fresh one; empty keeps the config file's (default 10)

arg.name: world_load_timeout_seconds
arg.description: the same for LoadWorld, an ego's Spawn and the weather; empty keeps the config file's (default 120)

arg.name: config_file
arg.description: bridge_config.yaml (the world server, the agent relay, asset map, traces)

arg.name: ssv2_port
arg.description: ZMQ port SSv2 connects to; empty keeps the config file's

arg.name: agent_relay
arg.description: tcp://host:port of the agent relay that drives entities with controller `agent`; empty keeps the config file's (default tcp://localhost:5560)

arg.name: npc_motion
arg.description: kinematic | tracked: how SSv2-driven NPCs move (roadmaps 023, 044); empty keeps the config file's (default tracked)

arg.name: weather
arg.description: weather preset (ClearNoon, CloudySunset, HardRainNight, ...) for a world server with weather, kept across map loads; empty keeps the config file's (default: leave the simulator's). Change at run time with /carla/set_weather

arg.name: gap_trace_dir
arg.description: where each episode's gap trace (roadmap 024) is written for gap_oracle; empty keeps the config file's (default: no trace)

arg.name: contact_report_dir
arg.description: where each ego run's contacts are written for physical_verdict (roadmap 021); 'off' disables; empty keeps the config file's (default ~/.ros/csb/contacts)
